title: The Call of Abraham
intro: Genesis 12 marks a turning point in salvation history. God calls Abram out from Ur and gives him promises that form the foundation of the entire biblical narrative - promises of land, people, and blessing for all families of the earth.

items.title: The Call: Leave!
items.note: Abram must leave everything - faith without seeing the destination

items.title: Promise: People, Blessing, and a New Name
items.note: Fulfilled in Israel and in the church of Christ

items.title: Promise: Protection and All Families
items.note: The promise of the Messiah - fulfilled in Christ (Gal 3:8)

items.title: The Altar at Bethel
items.note: Abram establishes worship in the new land

footer.title: The Abrahamic Covenant
footer.content: The promises to Abraham are the foundation of God's plan of salvation. Paul explains that "all families of the earth" includes the Gentiles, and that the blessing comes through faith - just as Abraham believed God ({{Gal 3:6-9}}). We are "Abraham's children" by faith in Christ.
